title: Informational website for land property share claim

requirements.text: Create a simple, responsive informational website (single-page or a few pages) that presents the owners’ claim to a rightful share of a land property, written in clear English.

quotes: I am along with my sibling are the owners of rightful share  of  some undisputed /disputed  land property  and  as such  I just need a              ' ' website "

acceptanceCriteria: Site loads successfully and is navigable on mobile and desktop.
All user-facing text is in English.
Content structure includes at minimum: (1) Intro/summary, (2) About the owners (siblings), (3) Property overview, (4) Claim summary (undisputed/disputed context), (5) Contact section.
Copy uses neutral, factual wording (no inflammatory language).

requirements.text: Add a clear content-editing pattern so the owners can update website text without touching layout code (e.g., a single structured content file consumed by the pages/sections).
acceptanceCriteria: There is a single, obvious place in the frontend codebase to edit the main website text content.
Updating the content file updates the rendered site without requiring edits across multiple components.

requirements.text: Include a “Documents / References” section that can display a list of document links (e.g., PDFs or images) served as static assets, with title, date (optional), and a short description for each item.
acceptanceCriteria: Documents section renders a list of items with at least: document title and a clickable link.
Document links point to static assets in the frontend build (no backend required).
If no documents are provided yet, the UI displays a clean empty-state message in English.

requirements.text: Add a visible disclaimer section stating the website is for informational purposes only and does not constitute legal advice, and that claims are presented as the owners’ position.
acceptanceCriteria: Disclaimer is visible from the main page (either as a section or in the footer).
Disclaimer text is written in clear English and avoids legal guarantees.

requirements.text: Define and apply a coherent visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for a formal property/claim informational site, and use it consistently across the website (avoid blue/purple palettes unless explicitly requested later).
acceptanceCriteria: Theme is consistent across sections (headings, body text, cards/sections, buttons/links).
Color palette is not primarily blue/purple.
Typography hierarchy is clear (at least H1/H2/body styles are distinguishable).

requirements.text: Render any generated images as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the site (e.g., hero illustration and favicon).
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI.
Hero/brand image is visible on the site.
Favicon is set and visible in the browser tab.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Frontend immutable paths (as defined by the platform) must not be edited; compose existing UI components instead of modifying read-only component sources.
Do not add third-party authentication; only Internet Identity is supported (and is not required for this informational website).
Do not introduce external databases or external hosting dependencies; serve documents as static frontend assets if included.
nonGoals: Providing legal advice or legal conclusions about the property dispute.
Building a full case-management system (e.g., evidence workflows, party messaging, court filing).
User accounts, role-based admin panels, or private document vaults (unless explicitly requested later).

required: Formal minimalist hero illustration depicting land boundaries and a document motif in neutral earth tones (land-hero.dim_1600x900.png)
Simple neutral favicon showing a minimal land-plot icon in monochrome/earth tone (favicon-land.dim_128x128.png)
